name: artcraft
description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers
one_liner: A drag-and-drop app for building AI-generated images and video where you pose the scene, characters, and camera precisely, instead of just typing a prompt and hoping.
buyer: A freelance video or motion designer, or a small ad agency, that currently pays for stock footage, actors, or 3D artists to stage a shot and wants controllable, repeatable scenes instead.
business_use_cases: An ad agency stages and renders product scenes (place product in a 3D-built setting, pick camera angle) without booking a studio or set.
A YouTube creator builds a consistent recurring character across episodes using the character identity transfer feature, instead of hiring an illustrator per scene.
An indie game studio pre-visualizes cutscenes and shot composition before committing art budget to a scene.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a 'virtual production studio' service: a client submits a script, the studio delivers staged, camera-directed AI scenes or video.
License reusable 3D asset kits (sets, characters, props) built for ArtCraft to other creators.

steal_this: A weekend 'AI storyboard artist' service: take a client's script and deliver a shot-by-shot staged visual storyboard using ArtCraft's scene tools.
